scope: field diagnostic only: KE-H2 GLORYS normalization (data), primary AVISO-grid comparisons A/B/C, HYCOM_NATIVE_FIELD_DIAGNOSTIC (A), depth diagnostic (C at D05/D10/D15/D20 where registered), frozen STEP 25C trajectory context, figures 1-7 per window; no model run, no download, no parameter change

questionRules.Q1: per window: implied 72 h displacement of the A median vector difference (median|delta| x 259200 s) divided by the STEP 25C per-window median GLORYS-HYCOM 72 h separation; COMPARABLE_ORDER if ratio in [1/3, 3], FIELD_SMALLER if < 1/3, FIELD_LARGER if > 3; overall label = class reached by >= 3 of 4 windows, else MIXED
questionRules.Q2Q3: per window with both B and C: closer = lower median vector difference to AVISO; GLORYS/HYCOM descriptively closer if >= 3 of 4 windows agree; otherwise no clear field-level difference; AVISO is a reference field, not ground truth
questionRules.Q4: per window (comparison A): MAGNITUDE if |median relative speed difference| >= 0.25, DIRECTION if median absolute direction difference >= 30 degrees, MAGNITUDE_AND_DIRECTION if both, SPATIAL_STRUCTURE if neither and Pearson r(u) or r(v) < 0.5, else NONE_DOMINANT; overall = class reached by >= 3 of 4 windows, else MIXED
questionRules.Q5: per window: max |relative change| of the C median vector difference at D05/D10/D20 versus D15; MATERIAL if > 0.10 in >= 3 of 4 windows (KE-1, KE-2, KE-H1, KE-H3), else NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE_WITH_DEPTH; no ranking
questionRules.Q6: rank concordance between the STEP 25C per-window trajectory separation and the A median vector difference over the windows with both (pairs concordant / (concordant + discordant)); RANK_CONSISTENT if >= 5/6, RANK_INCONSISTENT if <= 1/6, else MIXED; evidence at most PLAUSIBLE_BUT_UNTESTED (n = 4)

requiredStatements: STEP 28 is a forcing-field diagnostic with AVISO as a surface-geostrophic REFERENCE FIELD, not ground truth; no model performance result is produced.
No trajectory was run; alpha = 0.002, depths, windage, weights and blending are unchanged; no forcing or depth is selected.
HYCOM is compared at its exact instantaneous frame at T; GLORYS by the daily mean of the UTC day containing T (label T - 12 h); this cadence distinction is recorded and not removed.
KE-H2 contributes GLORYS-AVISO only (HYCOM frame missing per immutable STEP 20); AG-1 and AG-2 are not AVISO-eligible.
Trajectory context uses frozen STEP 25C values only; no M3 was recomputed; no regression or causal attribution was made.
